title: The Glory of the Lord Leaves the Temple
description: Ezekiel sees the glory of the Lord above the cherubim. A man clothed in linen is commanded to take burning coals from between the cherubim and scatter them over the city as judgment. The glory of the Lord rises from the cherub, leaves the threshold of the house, and stands above the cherubim, which then lift themselves up and stop at the entrance of the east gate [ref:Ezekiel 10:1-19|Ezekiel 10:1-19].
